name: Yoga Nidra
title: Yoga Nidra

lede.guided: Lie down, press Begin, and put the phone beside you. The guru talks you through the whole practice: there's nothing to remember and nothing to do but listen. Falling asleep is fine.

cycleNote: Keep the same sankalpa for the whole cycle. The day count goes up each day you practise; a missed day doesn't reset it.
facts: On your back, legs a little apart, arms by your sides, palms up.
A pillow under the head or knees, and a blanket: the body cools as it rests.
Don't move once it begins. Try to stay awake, but sleeping is fine.
release: Yoga Nidra rests the body deeply while awareness stays switched on. You travel through the body, the breath and a few images, and plant a short resolve, your sankalpa, where the mind is most open to it.
guidelines: Choose your sankalpa before you start: short, positive and in the present tense, such as “I am calm” or “I am whole.”
Practise on an empty or light stomach. Afternoons and the hour before sleep both work well.
If you fall asleep, don't worry. Come back tomorrow; part of you was still listening.
Not ideal while driving or doing anything that needs your attention: it's designed to switch you off.

guided.name: Lying down
guided.read: Get comfortable on your back. Once it begins, you stay still. The guru brings your attention to sounds, then to the body lying on the floor.

guided.name: Sankalpa
guided.read: Say your short resolve silently, three times, with feeling.

guided.name: Through the body
guided.read: The guru names parts of the body in quick succession. Feel each one as it's named. No need to move.

guided.name: Counting breaths
guided.read: Watch the natural breath at the belly, then count breaths backwards from 27 to 1. Lose count? Start again.

guided.name: Opposites
guided.read: Heaviness, then lightness. Warmth, then cold. Let each feeling arise, then let it go.

guided.name: Images
guided.read: A string of simple images, named one after another. Let each appear however it comes, then watch the dark space behind the eyes.

guided.name: Deep rest
guided.read: Silent, deep rest for the extra time you chose. Drift if you like; the guru brings you back.

guided.name: Coming back
guided.read: Slowly back to the breath, the body and the room. Roll onto your side before you sit up.

say.settle_1: Today... Yoga Nidra. Yogic sleep... where the body sleeps... and you stay awake. Lie on your back... legs a little apart... arms by your sides... palms up. Let the feet fall open.
say.settle_2: Make yourself comfortable... because this is the last time you will move. If you fall asleep... no problem. Something in you... is still listening.
say.settle_3: Become aware of the sounds around you... far away... nearby. Let them come... and go. Now feel the body... lying on the floor. Heavy... and still.
say.settle_4: Say to yourself, silently... I am awake. I am practising Yoga Nidra.
say.sankalpa: Now... your sankalpa. A short resolve... simple, positive... in the present tense. I am calm. Or... I am whole. Choose it... and say it silently... three times... with feeling.
say.rot_intro: Now we travel through the body. As I name each part... simply feel it. No need to move. Quickly... lightly.
say.rot_1: Right hand thumb... second finger... third finger... fourth finger... little finger. Palm of the hand... back of the hand... the wrist.
say.rot_2: Forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit. Right side of the waist... right hip... thigh... knee... shin... ankle... heel... sole of the foot... top of the foot. Big toe... second toe... third toe... fourth toe... little toe.
say.rot_3: Left hand thumb... second finger... third finger... fourth finger... little finger. Palm of the hand... back of the hand... the wrist.
say.rot_4: Forearm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit. Left side of the waist... left hip... thigh... knee... shin... ankle... heel... sole of the foot... top of the foot. Big toe... second toe... third toe... fourth toe... little toe.
say.rot_5: Now the back. Right shoulder blade... left shoulder blade... the whole spine... the lower back... the buttocks... the back of the head.
say.rot_6: Now the face. The top of the head... the forehead... right eyebrow... left eyebrow... the space between the eyebrows. Right eye... left eye... right ear... left ear... right cheek... left cheek. The nose... the tip of the nose... upper lip... lower lip... the chin... the jaw... the throat.
say.rot_7: Right side of the chest... left side of the chest... the middle of the chest. The navel... the belly... the lower belly.
say.rot_8: The whole right leg... the whole left leg... both legs together. The whole right arm... the whole left arm... both arms together. The whole back... the whole front... the whole head. The whole body... the whole body... the whole body.
say.breath_1: Now... become aware of the natural breath. Don't change it... just watch. The belly rising... the belly falling.
say.breath_2: Now count the breaths backwards... from twenty-seven... down to one. Breathing in... twenty-seven. Breathing out... twenty-seven. Breathing in... twenty-six... and so on. Lose count? Start again at twenty-seven. No penalty. I am not keeping score.
say.opp_1: Now... awaken the feeling of heaviness. The body is heavy... very heavy... sinking into the floor. Heavy arms... heavy legs... a heavy head.
say.opp_2: Now... lightness. The body is light... so light it could float... rising from the floor... light as a feather.
say.opp_3: Now... warmth. Remember the sun on your skin... the whole body... warm.
say.opp_4: And now... cold. A cool wind... cold water on the feet... the whole body... cool.
say.vis_1: Now I will name some images. Let each one appear... however it comes... and let it go.
say.vis_2: A lit candle... a still lake at dawn... a mountain covered in snow... the ocean at night... a temple bell ringing... a tall tree in the wind.
say.vis_3: A golden sunrise... a flower opening... a single bird crossing the sky... rain on a roof... a quiet path through a forest... your own body, lying here... perfectly still.
say.vis_4: Now... the space behind the closed eyes. Simply watch it... like a dark... open sky.
say.deep_rest: Now... simply rest here. Nothing to do... nowhere to go. If you drift into sleep... let it happen. I will bring you back.
say.sankalpa_2: Now... remember your sankalpa. The same words... said silently... three times. A seed... planted in very good soil.
say.return_1: Now... slowly... come back. Become aware of the breath... the body lying on the floor... the sounds around you.
say.return_2: Move the fingers... the toes. Stretch, if you like. Roll onto your side... and rest there a moment. When you are ready... sit up... and open the eyes. Yoga Nidra... is complete.
say.complete: Well rested... and awake. A good combination.
